name: STIHL MSA 80 C-B
blurb: Battery saw. STIHL lists a 14″ bar and 1/4″ PICCO PM3 chain. PM3 at 1/4″ PICCO is .043″ in this catalog. The drive-link count is not in the chart.
intro: The STIHL MSA 80 C-B is marked NEW on the 2025 specification table (catalog p. 64, specifications as of 1 October 2024). That row lists a 14″ bar and 1/4″ PICCO PM3 chain. The saw-chain chart lists PM3 at .043″ for 1/4″ PICCO (code 3670). STIHL's drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167) does not name this model, so this page does not print a drive-link count. Count the drive links on the bar stamp before you order. The MSA 70 C-B, which the drive-link chart does list, is the same 1/4″ PM3 family at .043″ with 64 links on a 12″ bar. That count is not this saw's count. STIHL's file table lists 1/8″ (3.2 mm) for 1/4″ PICCO.
notice: No drive-link count is published for the MSA 80 C-B in this catalog. Use the bar stamp.

bars.note: Specification table (catalog p. 64, as of 1 October 2024): 14″ bar, 1/4″ PICCO, chain type PM3. The chain-type chart lists 1/4″ PICCO PM3 at .043″ (code 3670). No drive-link count is printed for the MSA 80 C-B. STIHL's file table lists 1/8″ for 1/4″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: specification tables (catalog pp. 64–67, specifications as of 1 October 2024) and the guide-bar drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167), including the file table and the PMM3/PM3 chain-type rows

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, specification table (catalog p. 64, as of 1 October 2024) and PM3 chain-type row (1/4″ PICCO at .043″, code 3670), read 7 Nov 2026. The battery drive-link chart (catalog p. 167) does not name the MSA 80 C-B.
